title: the WSG effects on equipment - the water, sand and dust rules
audit_comment: The equipment effects slice pins the water, rust, leather, sand and dust rules (rules/wsgequip.h, prefix weq): the moisture and rust mechanics, the leather and rope rules, the wet-arrow penalty and the chafe penalties; census 355 -> 356.

banner.title: The WSG EFFECTS ON EQUIPMENT, R431: the water and rust rules (the 2-day drying, the 2-week oiling, the armor crack, the shield split, the weapon break), the leather and rope rules, the wet-clothing temperature shift and the sand/dust chafe rules - the section closes the effects-of-the-environment chapter WHOLE.
banner.provenance: Provenance: the WSG scan (archive.org item pdfy-B3Fz83tZ3TV7zOc8), printed pp. 28-29; the user own copy OCR cross-checked against the djvu text layer, every number matched.

consts.name: weqWetClothesDeltaTemp
consts.comment: Wet clothing at 30 degrees counts as 10 degrees colder.

consts.name: weqRustDryDays
consts.comment: Dry metal off once every 2 days.

consts.name: weqRustOilWeeks
consts.comment: Oil or protect metal once every 2 weeks.

consts.name: weqArmorCrackRoll
consts.comment: The rusted-armor crack trigger: an unmodified 20.

consts.name: weqArmorCrackDmgMin
consts.comment: The crack needs more than 4 points of damage.

consts.name: weqWeaponBreakRoll
consts.comment: The rusted-weapon break trigger: an unmodified 1.

consts.name: weqBootsDryDays
consts.comment: Thoroughly dry boots once every 2 days or so.

consts.name: weqWetArrowPenalty
consts.comment: A waterlogged arrow: -1 to hit and damage for a non-specialist.

consts.name: weqChafeSurpriseDen
consts.comment: Sand chafe: the surprise chance +1 in 6.

consts.name: weqChafeDexPenalty
consts.comment: Severe chafe: -1 dexterity for dodging and abrupt moves.

bools.name: weqRustedArmorNoAcPenalty
bools.comment: Rusted armor suffers no direct AC penalty.

bools.name: weqArmorCrackOneStepWorse
bools.comment: A cracked armor is one AC step worse.

bools.name: weqArmorSecondHitBreaks
bools.comment: A second crack hit breaks the armor entirely until repaired.

bools.name: weqShieldNearMissSplits
bools.comment: A shield hit at one under the needed roll may split it.

bools.name: weqLeatherCrackedAsRusted
bools.comment: Cracked leather armor treats blows like rusted metal armor.

bools.name: weqLeatherHeatCracks
bools.comment: Too much heat cracks leather drying it.

bools.name: weqMudCanCrackLeather
bools.comment: Excessive dried mud can crack leather too.

bools.name: weqWetKnotHardToUntie
bools.comment: A dry-made knot in a wet rope is hard to untie.

bools.name: weqDryKnotLoosens
bools.comment: A wet-made knot weakens after the rope dries.

bools.name: weqArrowSpecialistExempt
bools.comment: A bow specialist takes no wet-arrow penalty.

bools.name: weqMagicalInkWaterproof
bools.comment: Spell and protection scrolls use waterproof ink.

bools.name: weqSandAbrasionNegligible
bools.comment: Sand abrasion has no short-term effect in the vast majority of sandstorms.

bools.name: weqSandPotionDmCall
bools.comment: A sand-contaminated potion may be untainted, ruined or poison at the DM discretion.

bools.name: weqDustNotAbrasive
bools.comment: Dust is not abrasive; it penetrates further than sand.

bools.name: weqDustNoChafe
bools.comment: Dust in clothing does not chafe; no prompt cleaning needed.

examples.note: the wet-clothing example: wet gear at 30 degrees acts as 20 (10 colder)
the armor crack gates: an unmodified 20 AND over 4 damage, then 1 in 3
the shield and weapon breaks: 50 percent on the near-miss, 1 in 3 on the unmodified 1
the chafe penalties: +1 in 6 surprise, 3/4 speed, -1 dex
examples.expr: m['weqChafeSurpriseDen']() != 6 or 3 * m['weqChafeMoveDen']() != 4 * m['weqChafeMoveNum']() or m['weqChafeDexPenalty']() != -1
